actual_128_logic: Planned faithful implementation on each P_fit/U_fit; P and U membership are the only training labels. Validation/test rows are scored by every fitted tree. OOB aggregation is retained for U_fit diagnostics only.
authority_note: No Wu-author official repository was located. Ouyang author code independently reproduces T=1000, K=n_P and a balanced unconstrained DT but is not Wu's official implementation.
critical_ambiguity: No executable 128 adapter exists in this phase.
fit_semantics: P=inventory-supported positive; U=matched non-inventory controls, not verified negatives
implementation_choices: U subset multiplier and class_weight because the paper record does not uniquely freeze all software settings
original_paper_logic: Repeatedly sample U, temporarily label sampled U as class 0, train a decision tree with all P as class 1, and average positive-class scores; U OOB predictions exclude bags containing that U row.
seed_policy: fixed per outer fold/config before execution; never selected by test metrics
